shellCommands.command: git diff && cat package.json && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -path ./.git -prune -o -type f -print | head -50 && ls node_modules/next/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head

cat next.config.ts components/request-metadata.tsx app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx tsconfig.json; cat node_modules/next/package.json | grep '"version"'; grep -ril "cacheComponents" node_modules/next/dist/docs | head -30

(npx next start -p 3123 >/tmp/srv.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 4; for i in 1 2; do curl -s localhost:3123 | grep -o 'Operations</nav>\|Request [^<]*\(<!-- -->[^<]*\)*' | head -3; echo ---; done; pkill -f "next start" ; git status --short
